question.problem:
The number of heads facing upward after tossing $2$ unfair coins follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. What is the expected value of the number of heads facing upward after tossing the $2$ coins?

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{9}$ | $\frac{4}{9}$ | $\frac{4}{9}$ |
question.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =0\cdot f(0)+1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2) \\  & =0(\frac{1}{9})+1(\frac{4}{9})+2(\frac{4}{9}) \\  & =0+\frac{4}{9}+\frac{8}{9} \\  & =\frac{4+8}{9} \\  & =\frac{4}{3}\,.\end{aligned}
$$
